requirements: R1: The backend PR event processor must correctly detect when a PR is closed without being merged and update the associated task's status to a failed or unmerged state instead of done.

slices.title: Patch PR closed event handler for unmerged status
slices.jtbd: When implementing the GitHub webhook handler for this epic, I want to update the task status using an atomic guard when a PR is closed without merge, so that systemic synchronization drift is eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PR webhook payload indicating a 'closed' action with 'merged: false',
When the system processes the event,
Then the corresponding task status is updated to failed/unmerged using an atomic database update (UPDATE ... WHERE id = ? AND status = ?).
Given an existing task status that is already set to done,
When a late PR closed event arrives,
Then the system must safely handle or ignore the transition appropriately.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false-positive done tasks due to closed-unmerged PRs to 0

slices.title: Verify task status synchronization for closed PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to verify that tasks linked to unmerged PRs are not falsely marked as done, so that the synchronization drift fix is proven correct.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the test environment,
When a simulated PR closed event (without merge) is received,
Then the corresponding task status in the database is verified to not be 'done'.
Given the E2E test setup,
When a task is processed and its PR is rejected,
Then the integration confirms the task flow halts or resets correctly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage for PR-closed-without-merge webhook events
